entries.title: Revelation 10:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 A mighty strong angel appears with a book open in his hand. 6 He swears by him that lives for ever, that there shall be no more time. 9 John is commanded to take and eat the book.
